## About
Strathmore Air Conditioning Inc is a family owned heating and cooling contractor on Englishtown Rd in Old Bridge. We are the local dealer for Coleman heating and air conditioning equipment, and we install, service and repair systems for homes and businesses around Middlesex County.
Our technicians handle everything from routine maintenance and repairs on a home system to complete installations for commercial spaces. When we put in new equipment, we also show you how to look after it so it keeps running efficiently.
Keith comes up by name in our reviews, and one longtime customer wrote that he took the time to walk her family through every option before they chose a new system. That's how we like to work with our neighbors.

## Services
- Air conditioning repair: Diagnosis and repair when your central air stops cooling the way it should.
- Emergency air conditioning system repair: Repair for air conditioning systems that stop working and can't wait.
- Air conditioning installation: New Coleman air conditioning systems installed for homes and businesses, with guidance on keeping your equipment running efficiently.
- Heating system repair: Repairs for your heating system when it isn't keeping the house warm.
- Heating system replacement: Full replacements for heating systems that have reached the end of the road.
- Boiler service: Service for boiler heating systems.
- Indoor air quality: Indoor air quality products to help your home feel more comfortable.
- Humidifier installation: Humidifiers installed to add moisture to dry indoor air.
- Air duct balancing: Balancing so air moves evenly through your home.
- Thermostat repair: Fixing thermostats that aren't controlling your system properly.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. We offer free in-home estimates.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, we have financing options for new equipment.

Q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
A: Yes. We install equipment and handle service at both residential and commercial locations.

Q: Do you offer service agreements?
A: Yes, we offer planned service agreements to keep your system maintained.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday during the day and Saturday mornings. We're closed Sunday.
